' DANMAKU - a vertical scrolling bullet hell shooter for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Five stages, each with a boss at the end. Easy: clear every stage once. Medium: clear them all
' twice (the second loop is faster and meaner). Hard: twice through on one life.
'
' Keys: Q A O P move. Space (or Kempston fire): tap for a spread of shots, hold for the laser
'       (stronger, but you move slower). M (or Enter, or Kempston fire 2): a bomb - it clears
'       the bullets and hurts everything on screen.
' Kills in quick succession build the HIT chain: each kill scores more while it lasts.
'
' The background is Layer 2 blocks scrolled by the hardware (Bg.cls); the bullets and shots are
' hardware sprites moved and checked in Z80 (Bul.cls); the panel and the messages are the
' tilemap (on top); the sound is the AY.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NE = 20, NI = 3
' sprite slots (Bul has 50-127)
Const SP_PLAYER = 0, SP_LASER = 1, SP_FLARE = 11, SP_SPARK = 12, SP_EN = 13, SP_ITEM = 33, SP_BOSS = 36
Const BOXBOSS = 20
' enemy kinds
Const K_POP = 1, K_DART = 2, K_TANK = 3, K_TURRET = 4, K_CARRIER = 5, K_GUNSHIP = 6, K_BOOM = 7, K_BIGBOOM = 8
' a stage: waves until STAGELEN, the warning, the boss
Const STAGELEN = 2100, WARNAT = 2150, BOSSAT = 2300
' where the ship can go (sprite coordinates: the play area is 32-223 both ways)
Const XMIN = 40, XMAX = 216, YMIN = 44, YMAX = 214
' bullet colours (sprite palettes)
Const PINK = 2, BLUE = 3, GOLD = 4

Dim longText As String Max 120
' enemies: kind, position and speed (16ths of a pixel), life, timer, mode, when it fires, a hit flash
Dim ek(19) As Integer, ex(19) As Integer, ey(19) As Integer, evx(19) As Integer, evy(19) As Integer
Dim ehp(19) As Integer, et(19) As Integer, ea(19) As Integer, efire(19) As Integer, ef(19) As Integer
' each kind: life, score, half its box, sprite pattern, twice the size, in the air (hits the ship)
Dim khp(8) As Integer, kscore(8) As Integer, kbox(8) As Integer, kpat(8) As Integer, kbig(8) As Integer, kair(8) As Integer
' items: kind (1 power, 2 bomb, 3 score), position (pixels)
Dim ik(2) As Integer, ix(2) As Integer, iy(2) As Integer
' the boss
Dim bossOn As Integer, bossX As Integer, bossY As Integer, bossHP As Integer, bossMax As Integer, bossPh As Integer
Dim bossDie As Integer, bossVX As Integer, bossFl As Integer, bossBarV As Integer
' its two guns, per phase: type, interval, count, speed, spin, bullet, colour (3 phases x 2 x 7)
Dim em(41) As Integer, emT(1) As Integer, emAng(1) As Integer
' the map being made: the path's column, rows until it may turn, building tops waiting, a row
Dim pc As Integer, pturn As Integer, pend(11) As Integer, rowc(11) As Integer, noSpawn As Integer
' the ship
Dim px As Integer, py As Integer, alive As Integer, inv As Integer, deadT As Integer, power As Integer
Dim lives As Integer, bombs As Integer, bombT As Integer, fireHeld As Integer, burst As Integer, laserOn As Integer
Dim fireWas As Integer, bombWas As Integer, shotCool As Integer, laserHit As Integer, laserDmg As Integer, mx As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, nextExtend As Long
Dim chain As Integer, chainT As Integer, maxChain As Integer, gaugeWas As Integer
Dim mode As Integer, loopN As Integer, stage As Integer, stageT As Integer, frames As Integer, over As Integer
Dim cleared As Integer, clearT As Integer, msgT As Integer, waveT As Integer, sparkT As Integer, spdMul As Integer
Dim scoreDirty As Integer, altPal As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer

Setup
Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Bg.Init BgData.Blocks(), BgData.Colours()
Bul.Init GfxData.S_SHOT
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderUSL                   ' the tilemap on top (the panel, messages), sprites, Layer 2
Nx.Reg &H1C, 2                          ' the sprites cut to the play area (x halved: over the border)
Nx.Reg &H19, 16 : Nx.Reg &H19, 111 : Nx.Reg &H19, 32 : Nx.Reg &H19, 223
Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) Or &H20
hiscore = 100000
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- tables
Sub Setup()
  Kind K_POP, 3, 100, 9, GfxData.S_POP, 0, 1
  Kind K_DART, 5, 200, 9, GfxData.S_DART, 0, 1
  Kind K_TANK, 10, 300, 9, GfxData.S_TANK, 0, 0
  Kind K_TURRET, 16, 500, 9, GfxData.S_TURRET, 0, 0
  Kind K_CARRIER, 40, 1000, 17, GfxData.S_CARRIER, 1, 1
  Kind K_GUNSHIP, 130, 3000, 17, GfxData.S_GUNSHIP, 1, 1
End Sub

Sub Kind(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal hp As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer, ByVal box As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal big As Integer, ByVal air As Integer)
  khp(kd) = hp : kscore(kd) = sc : kbox(kd) = box : kpat(kd) = pat : kbig(kd) = big : kair(kd) = air
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim y As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50 : Spr.Show
  Bul.Reset : Bul.Show
  stage = 1 : loopN = 1
  StartMap
  noSpawn = 1
  Panel
  Tiles.Text 9, 6, "D A N M A K U"
  Tiles.Text 7, 8, "BULLET HELL SHOOTER"
  Tiles.Text 5, 11, "1  EASY"
  Tiles.Text 8, 12, "EVERY STAGE ONCE"
  Tiles.Text 5, 14, "2  MEDIUM"
  Tiles.Text 8, 15, "EVERY STAGE TWICE"
  Tiles.Text 5, 17, "3  HARD"
  Tiles.Text 8, 18, "TWICE ON ONE LIFE"
  Tiles.Text 5, 21, "Q A O P   MOVE"
  Tiles.Text 5, 22, "SPACE     TAP: SHOT"
  Tiles.Text 5, 23, "          HOLD: LASER"
  Tiles.Text 5, 24, "M         BOMB"
  mode = 0 : y = 0
  Do
    If Bg.Phase() = 0 Then MakeRow
    Frame
    Bg.Scroll
    Sfx.Update
    y = y + 1
    If y = 30 Then Tiles.Text 9, 26, "PRESS 1, 2 OR 3"
    If y = 60 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 26, 24, 1, 0 : y = 0
    If Keys.Down(Keys.Key1) Then mode = 1
    If Keys.Down(Keys.Key2) Then mode = 2
    If Keys.Down(Keys.Key3) Then mode = 3
  Loop Until mode > 0
  Sfx.Play 0, 80, -2, 15, 25, 0
End Sub

' the panel on the right and round the edge; the play area see-through
Sub Panel()
  Tiles.Fill GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 24, 24, 0
  For k = 4 To 27
    Tiles.Put 28, k, GfxData.T_PANELL
  Next
  Tiles.Text 29, 4, "SCORE"
  Tiles.Text 29, 7, "HI"
  Tiles.Text 29, 10, "STAGE"
  Tiles.Text 29, 13, "LIFE"
  Tiles.Text 29, 16, "BOMB"
  Tiles.Text 29, 19, "HIT"
  Tiles.Text 29, 23, "MAX HIT"
  ShowHi
End Sub

Sub ShowScore()
  Tiles.Text 29, 5, Right$("0000000" & Trim$(Str$(score)), 7)
  scoreDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub ShowHi()
  Tiles.Text 29, 8, Right$("0000000" & Trim$(Str$(hiscore)), 7)
End Sub

Sub ShowStage()
  Tiles.Text 29, 11, Trim$(Str$(loopN)) & "-" & Trim$(Str$(stage)) & "    "
  If mode = 1 Then Tiles.Text 29, 26, "EASY  "
  If mode = 2 Then Tiles.Text 29, 26, "MEDIUM"
  If mode = 3 Then Tiles.Text 29, 26, "HARD  "
End Sub

Sub ShowLives()
  For k = 0 To 5
    If k < lives Then Tiles.Put 29 + k, 14, GfxData.T_LIFE Else Tiles.Put 29 + k, 14, GfxData.T_PANEL
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowBombs()
  For k = 0 To 5
    If k < bombs Then Tiles.Put 29 + k, 17, GfxData.T_BOMB Else Tiles.Put 29 + k, 17, GfxData.T_PANEL
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowChain()
  Tiles.Text 29, 20, Trim$(Str$(chain)) & "    "
  Tiles.Text 29, 24, Trim$(Str$(maxChain)) & "    "
End Sub

' the chain gauge: 6 cells, 48 steps
Sub ShowGauge()
  Dim v As Integer, f As Integer
  v = chainT * 48 \ 90
  If v = gaugeWas Then Exit Sub
  gaugeWas = v
  For k = 0 To 5
    f = v - k * 8
    If f < 0 Then f = 0
    If f > 8 Then f = 8
    Tiles.Put 29 + k, 21, GfxData.T_GAUGE + f
  Next
End Sub

' a message across the middle of the play area for t frames
Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal t As Integer)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, 14, 24, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 4 + (24 - Len(longText)) \ 2, 14, longText
  msgT = t
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the background
' a stage's look: its colours, and the whole screen drawn
Sub StartMap()
  Bg.Theme stage - 1
  Nx.Seed stage * 31 + loopN * 7
  pc = 5 : pturn = 0
  For k = 0 To 11
    pend(k) = 0
  Next
  noSpawn = 1
  For k = 1 To 192
    If Bg.Phase() = 0 Then MakeRow
    Bg.Scroll
  Next
  noSpawn = 0
End Sub

' the stage's ground
Function Ground() As Integer
  Dim r As Integer
  r = Rnd(16)
  If stage = 1 Then
    If r < 8 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_G1
    ElseIf r < 12 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_G2
    ElseIf r < 15 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_G3
    Else
      Ground = BgData.B_TREES
    End If
  ElseIf stage = 3 Then
    If r < 8 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_PLATE
    ElseIf r < 12 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_PLATE2
    ElseIf r < 15 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_GRILLE
    Else
      Ground = BgData.B_STRIPE
    End If
  ElseIf stage = 4 Then
    If r < 12 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_DARK
    ElseIf r < 14 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_PLATE
    ElseIf r < 15 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_PLATE2
    Else
      Ground = BgData.B_STRIPE
    End If
  Else
    If r < 7 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_G1
    ElseIf r < 11 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_G2
    ElseIf r < 15 Then
      Ground = BgData.B_G3
    Else
      Ground = BgData.B_CRATER
    End If
  End If
End Function

' the next row of blocks: ground, the path winding up the screen, buildings and things on it
Sub MakeRow()
  Dim c As Integer, r As Integer, tc As Integer, lo As Integer, hi As Integer, busy As Integer, n As Integer
  busy = 0
  For c = 0 To 11
    If pend(c) Then
      rowc(c) = pend(c) : pend(c) = 0 : busy = 1
    Else
      rowc(c) = Ground()
    End If
  Next
  If pturn > 0 Then pturn = pturn - 1
  If pturn = 0 And busy = 0 And Rnd(100) < 14 Then
    tc = pc + (2 + Rnd(3)) * (1 - 2 * Rnd(2))
    If tc < 1 Then tc = 1 + Rnd(2)
    If tc > 10 Then tc = 10 - Rnd(2)
    If tc = pc Then
      If pc > 5 Then tc = pc - 2 Else tc = pc + 2
    End If
    If tc < pc Then
      rowc(pc) = BgData.B_PSW : rowc(tc) = BgData.B_PNE : lo = tc + 1 : hi = pc - 1
    Else
      rowc(pc) = BgData.B_PSE : rowc(tc) = BgData.B_PNW : lo = pc + 1 : hi = tc - 1
    End If
    For c = lo To hi
      rowc(c) = BgData.B_PH
    Next
    pc = tc : pturn = 3
  Else
    rowc(pc) = BgData.B_PV
  End If
  ' on the ground: buildings (two by two), pads with guns, the stage's own things
  If busy = 0 Then
    c = 0
    Do While c < 12
      If rowc(c) <= BgData.B_G3 Or rowc(c) >= BgData.B_PLATE Then
        r = Rnd(100)
        If r < 5 And c < 11 Then
          If rowc(c + 1) <= BgData.B_G3 Or rowc(c + 1) >= BgData.B_PLATE Then
            If rowc(c + 1) <> BgData.B_PV Then
              rowc(c) = BgData.B_BBL : rowc(c + 1) = BgData.B_BBR
              pend(c) = BgData.B_BTL : pend(c + 1) = BgData.B_BTR
              c = c + 1
            End If
          End If
        ElseIf r < 6 + (stage + 1) \ 2 Then
          rowc(c) = BgData.B_PAD
          If noSpawn = 0 And stageT < STAGELEN - 100 Then
            n = Spawn(K_TURRET, 40 + c * 16, 24)
          End If
        ElseIf r < 10 Then
          If stage = 1 Then
            rowc(c) = BgData.B_TANKS
          ElseIf stage = 2 Then
            rowc(c) = BgData.B_VENT
          ElseIf stage = 3 Then
            rowc(c) = BgData.B_TOWER
          ElseIf stage = 4 Then
            rowc(c) = BgData.B_TOWER
          Else
            rowc(c) = BgData.B_CRATER
          End If
        End If
      End If
      c = c + 1
    Loop
  End If
  For c = 0 To 11
    Bg.Cell c, rowc(c)
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Game()
  If mode = 3 Then lives = 1 Else lives = 3
  bombs = 3 : power = 1 : score = 0 : chain = 0 : maxChain = 0 : loopN = 1 : stage = 1 : over = 0
  nextExtend = 500000
  Do
    StageRun
    If over Then Exit Do
    stage = stage + 1
    If stage > 5 Then
      If mode = 1 Or loopN = 2 Then
        Ending "ALL CLEAR!"
        Exit Sub
      End If
      loopN = 2 : stage = 1
    End If
  Loop
  Ending "GAME OVER"
End Sub

Sub Ending(ByVal m As String)
  Dim n As Integer, f As Integer, up As Integer
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  ShowHi
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50
  Bul.Reset
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 24, 1, 0
  Message m, 0
  If longText = "ALL CLEAR!" Then
    Tiles.Text 6, 16, "YOU BEAT THEM ALL"
    Sfx.Play 0, 100, -3, 15, 60, 0
  End If
  ' 6 seconds, or Space (or fire) after the first second: let go of it first, then press it
  up = 0
  For n = 1 To 300
    If Bg.Phase() = 0 Then MakeRow
    Frame
    Bg.Scroll
    Spr.Show
    Bul.Show
    Sfx.Update
    f = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
    If f = 0 Then
      up = 1
    ElseIf up And n > 50 Then
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' one stage, from the scroll in to the boss beaten (or the last life lost)
Sub StageRun()
  For k = 0 To NE - 1
    ek(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NI - 1
    ik(k) = 0
  Next
  bossOn = 0 : bossBarV = 0
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50
  Bul.Reset
  If loopN = 2 Then spdMul = 5 Else spdMul = 4
  If stage >= 3 Then altPal = Spr.Pal * 10 Else altPal = 0
  stageT = 0
  StartMap
  Panel
  ShowScore : ShowStage : ShowLives : ShowBombs : ShowChain : gaugeWas = -1 : ShowGauge
  px = 128 : py = 200 : alive = 1 : inv = 100 : deadT = 0 : laserOn = 0 : burst = 0 : bombT = 0
  fireWas = 1 : bombWas = 1 : laserHit = -1
  waveT = 90 : cleared = 0 : clearT = 0 : sparkT = 0
  If loopN = 2 And stage = 1 Then
    Message "SECOND LOOP - STAGE 1", 180
  Else
    Message "STAGE " & Trim$(Str$(stage)), 150
  End If
  Do
    stageT = stageT + 1
    Waves
    PlayerMove
    LaserUpdate
    Enemies
    BossUpdate
    Items
    BombUpdate
    If alive Then Bul.Step px, py Else Bul.Step 0, 0
    If alive And inv = 0 And bombT = 0 Then
      If Bul.Hit() Then Die
    End If
    If chainT > 0 Then
      chainT = chainT - 1
      If chainT = 0 Then chain = 0 : ShowChain
    End If
    DrawPlayer
    If (frames And 3) = 0 Then
      If scoreDirty Then ShowScore
      ShowGauge
      If bossOn Then BossBar
    End If
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 14, 24, 1, 0
    End If
    If Bg.Phase() = 0 Then MakeRow
    Frame
    Bg.Scroll
    Spr.Show
    Bul.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If alive = 0 And deadT = 0 And lives = 0 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
    If cleared Then
      clearT = clearT + 1
      If clearT = 1 Then Message "STAGE CLEAR", 160
      If clearT > 170 Then Exit Sub
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  scoreDirty = 1
  If mode < 3 And score >= nextExtend Then
    lives = lives + 1 : ShowLives
    nextExtend = nextExtend + 1000000
    Sfx.Play 1, 60, -1, 15, 40, 0
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the ship
Sub PlayerMove()
  Dim j0 As Integer, my As Integer, sp As Integer, fire As Integer, bomb As Integer
  If alive = 0 Then
    If deadT > 0 Then
      deadT = deadT - 1
      If deadT = 0 And lives > 0 Then
        alive = 1 : px = 128 : py = YMAX : inv = 150 : bombs = 3 : ShowBombs
      End If
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  If laserOn Then sp = 1 Else sp = 2
  px = px + mx * sp : py = py + my * sp
  If px < XMIN Then px = XMIN
  If px > XMAX Then px = XMAX
  If py < YMIN Then py = YMIN
  If py > YMAX Then py = YMAX
  ' tap: a burst of shots; hold: the laser
  fire = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or ((j0 And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
  If fire Then
    fireHeld = fireHeld + 1
    If fireWas = 0 Then burst = 14
    If fireHeld > 14 Then laserOn = 1
  Else
    fireHeld = 0 : laserOn = 0
  End If
  fireWas = fire
  If burst > 0 Then burst = burst - 1
  If shotCool > 0 Then shotCool = shotCool - 1
  If laserOn = 0 And burst > 0 And shotCool = 0 Then
    Bul.Shot px - 4, py - 10, 0
    Bul.Shot px + 4, py - 10, 0
    If power >= 2 Then
      Bul.Shot px - 8, py - 6, -1
      Bul.Shot px + 8, py - 6, 1
    End If
    If power >= 3 Then
      Bul.Shot px - 10, py - 2, -2
      Bul.Shot px + 10, py - 2, 2
    End If
    shotCool = 5
    Sfx.Play 0, 40, 6, 9, 3, 0
  End If
  If laserOn And (frames And 3) = 0 Then Sfx.Play 0, 18, 1, 8, 4, 1
  bomb = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or ((j0 And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
  If bomb And bombWas = 0 And bombs > 0 And bombT = 0 Then
    bombs = bombs - 1 : ShowBombs
    bombT = 60
    Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 60, 1
  End If
  bombWas = bomb
  If inv > 0 Then inv = inv - 1
End Sub

Sub DrawPlayer()
  Dim fr As Integer
  If alive = 0 Or (inv And 4) <> 0 Then
    Spr.Hide SP_PLAYER
  Else
    If mx < 0 Then
      fr = 1
    ElseIf mx > 0 Then
      fr = 2
    Else
      fr = 0
    End If
    Spr.Put SP_PLAYER, px - 8, py - 8, GfxData.S_PLAYER + fr, 0
  End If
  If sparkT > 0 Then sparkT = sparkT - 1
  If Bul.Sparked() Then
    sparkT = 3
    Spr.Put SP_SPARK, Bul.SparkX() - 8, Bul.SparkY() - 8, GfxData.S_SPARK, 0
  ElseIf sparkT = 0 Then
    Spr.Hide SP_SPARK
  End If
End Sub

' the laser: the nearest target above, the beam up to it
Sub LaserUpdate()
  Dim top As Integer, y As Integer
  laserHit = -1
  If laserOn = 0 Or alive = 0 Then
    Spr.HideRange SP_LASER, 11
    Exit Sub
  End If
  laserHit = Bul.Laser(px, py - 8)
  top = Bul.LaserTop()
  laserDmg = 1 + (power - 1) * (frames And 1)
  For k = 0 To 9
    y = top + k * 16
    If y < py - 20 Then
      Spr.Put SP_LASER + k, px - 8, y, GfxData.S_LASER, 0
    ElseIf k = 9 Or y >= py - 4 Then
      Spr.Hide SP_LASER + k
    Else
      Spr.Put SP_LASER + k, px - 8, py - 28, GfxData.S_LASER, 0
    End If
  Next
  If laserHit >= 0 Then
    If frames And 2 Then
      Spr.Put SP_FLARE, px - 8, top - 10, GfxData.S_LASER + 1, 0
    Else
      Spr.Put SP_FLARE, px - 8, top - 10, GfxData.S_LASER + 1, Spr.MirrorX
    End If
  Else
    Spr.Hide SP_FLARE
  End If
End Sub

Sub Die()
  Dim n As Integer
  alive = 0 : deadT = 100 : lives = lives - 1 : ShowLives
  laserOn = 0 : burst = 0
  n = Spawn(K_BIGBOOM, px, py)
  n = Bul.Clear()
  chain = 0 : chainT = 0 : ShowChain
  If power > 1 Then power = power - 1
  Spr.Hide SP_PLAYER
  Spr.HideRange SP_LASER, 11
  Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 70, 1
  Sfx.Play 1, 200, 12, 15, 50, 0
End Sub

Sub BombUpdate()
  Dim n As Integer
  If bombT = 0 Then Exit Sub
  bombT = bombT - 1
  n = Bul.Clear()
  If bombT = 0 Then
    Bg.Theme stage - 1
  ElseIf (bombT And 4) <> 0 Then
    Bg.Theme 5
  Else
    Bg.Theme stage - 1
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the waves
Sub Waves()
  Dim r As Integer, n As Integer, x As Integer, m As Integer, gap As Integer
  If stageT >= STAGELEN Then
    If stageT = WARNAT Then
      Message "WARNING!  A BIG ONE", 140
      Sfx.Play 2, 300, 0, 15, 30, 0
    End If
    If stageT = WARNAT + 40 Or stageT = WARNAT + 80 Then Sfx.Play 2, 300, 0, 15, 30, 0
    If stageT = BOSSAT Then StartBoss
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If stageT = 600 Or stageT = 1500 Then n = Spawn(K_CARRIER, 64 + Rnd(128), 8)
  If stage >= 2 And stageT = 1100 Then n = Spawn(K_GUNSHIP, 128, 8)
  If stage >= 4 And stageT = 1800 Then n = Spawn(K_GUNSHIP, 80 + Rnd(96), 8)
  waveT = waveT - 1
  If waveT > 0 Then Exit Sub
  gap = 110 - stage * 10
  If loopN = 2 Then gap = gap - 15
  waveT = gap
  r = Rnd(100)
  If stage = 1 And r >= 70 And r < 85 Then r = r + 15     ' no darts in stage 1
  If r < 30 Then
    ' a line of small fighters
    x = 48 + Rnd(40)
    For m = 0 To 3 + stage \ 2
      n = Spawn(K_POP, x + m * 24, 16)
      If n >= 0 Then ea(n) = 0
    Next
  ElseIf r < 50 Then
    ' a column, weaving
    x = 64 + Rnd(128)
    For m = 0 To 4
      n = Spawn(K_POP, x, 16 - m * 18)
      If n >= 0 Then ea(n) = 1
    Next
  ElseIf r < 70 Then
    ' down one side, then across
    If Rnd(2) Then x = 52 Else x = 204
    For m = 0 To 3
      n = Spawn(K_POP, x, 16 - m * 20)
      If n >= 0 Then
        If x < 128 Then ea(n) = 2 Else ea(n) = 3
      End If
    Next
  ElseIf r < 85 Then
    ' two divers
    n = Spawn(K_DART, 56 + Rnd(30), 16)
    n = Spawn(K_DART, 170 + Rnd(30), 16)
  Else
    ' tanks up the path and on the ground
    n = Spawn(K_TANK, 40 + pc * 16, 16)
    n = Spawn(K_TANK, 40 + Rnd(12) * 16, 16)
  End If
End Sub

' a new enemy of kind kd at x, y (pixels): its number, or -1 when there's no room
Function Spawn(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
  Dim m As Integer
  For m = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(m) = 0 Then
      ek(m) = kd : ex(m) = x * 16 + 8 : ey(m) = y * 16 + 8 : evx(m) = 0 : evy(m) = 0
      ehp(m) = khp(kd) : et(m) = 0 : ea(m) = 0 : ef(m) = 0
      If loopN = 2 Then ehp(m) = ehp(m) + ehp(m) \ 4
      efire(m) = -1
      If kd = K_POP Then
        evy(m) = 20
        If Rnd(5) < stage + loopN Then efire(m) = 30 + Rnd(50)
      ElseIf kd = K_DART Then
        evy(m) = 46 : evx(m) = (px - x) * 16 \ 44
      ElseIf kd = K_TANK Then
        evy(m) = 12 : efire(m) = 40 + Rnd(40)
      ElseIf kd = K_TURRET Then
        evy(m) = 16 : efire(m) = 30 + Rnd(40)
      ElseIf kd = K_CARRIER Then
        evy(m) = 9
      ElseIf kd = K_GUNSHIP Then
        evy(m) = 24
      End If
      Spawn = m
      Exit Function
    End If
  Next
  Spawn = -1
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- bullets
Sub Shoot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
  If y < 36 Or y > 216 Then Exit Sub
  Bul.Fire x, y, a And 255, spd * spdMul \ 4, GfxData.S_BULLET + pat, pal
End Sub

' n bullets fanned round the way to the ship, step apart
Sub Fan(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal stp As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
  Dim a As Integer, m As Integer
  If alive Then a = Bul.Aim(x, y, px, py) Else a = 0
  a = a - (n - 1) * stp \ 2
  For m = 1 To n
    Shoot x, y, a, spd, pat, pal
    a = a + stp
  Next
End Sub

' n bullets all round, starting at way a
Sub Ring(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer, st As Integer
  st = 256 \ n
  For m = 1 To n
    Shoot x, y, a, spd, pat, pal
    a = a + st
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the enemies
Sub Enemies()
  Dim m As Integer, kd As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, h As Integer, fl As Integer, pat As Integer, half As Integer, gone As Integer
  For m = 0 To NE - 1
    kd = ek(m)
    If kd >= K_BOOM Then
      et(m) = et(m) + 1
      ey(m) = ey(m) + evy(m)
      If et(m) >= 16 Then
        ek(m) = 0 : Spr.Hide SP_EN + m
      ElseIf kd = K_BIGBOOM Then
        Spr.Put SP_EN + m, ex(m) \ 16 - 16, ey(m) \ 16 - 16, GfxData.S_BOOM + et(m) \ 4, Spr.Scale2
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_EN + m, ex(m) \ 16 - 8, ey(m) \ 16 - 8, GfxData.S_BOOM + et(m) \ 4, 0
      End If
    ElseIf kd > 0 Then
      Move m, kd
      x = ex(m) \ 16 : y = ey(m) \ 16
      gone = 0
      If y > 240 Or x < 12 Or x > 244 Then gone = 1
      If y < 0 And et(m) > 40 Then gone = 1
      If gone Then
        ek(m) = 0 : Spr.Hide SP_EN + m : Bul.Off m
      Else
        h = Bul.Hits(m)
        If laserHit = m Then h = h + laserDmg
        If bombT > 0 And y >= 32 Then h = h + 2
        If h > 0 And y >= 30 Then
          ehp(m) = ehp(m) - h : ef(m) = 2 : chainT = 90
        End If
        If ehp(m) <= 0 Then
          Kill m, kd, x, y
        Else
          If y >= 20 Then Bul.Box m, x, y, kbox(kd), kbox(kd) Else Bul.Off m
          fl = altPal
          If ef(m) > 0 Then ef(m) = ef(m) - 1 : fl = Spr.Pal
          pat = kpat(kd)
          If kd = K_POP Then pat = pat + ((frames \ 4) And 1)
          If kbig(kd) Then
            Spr.Put SP_EN + m, x - 16, y - 16, pat, fl Or Spr.Scale2
            half = 13
          Else
            Spr.Put SP_EN + m, x - 8, y - 8, pat, fl
            half = 6
          End If
          ' flying into the ship
          If kair(kd) And alive And inv = 0 And bombT = 0 Then
            If Abs(x - px) < half And Abs(y - py) < half Then Die
          End If
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' how each kind moves and shoots
Sub Move(ByVal m As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, t As Integer
  t = et(m)
  x = ex(m) \ 16 : y = ey(m) \ 16
  If kd = K_POP Then
    If ea(m) = 1 Then
      If (t \ 24) And 1 Then evx(m) = 14 Else evx(m) = -14
    ElseIf ea(m) >= 2 And y > 96 And evy(m) > 8 Then
      evy(m) = 8
      If ea(m) = 2 Then evx(m) = 30 Else evx(m) = -30
    End If
    If t = efire(m) Then
      If loopN = 2 Then Fan x, y, 3, 14, 22, 0, PINK Else Fan x, y, 1, 0, 22, 0, PINK
    End If
  ElseIf kd = K_DART Then
    evy(m) = evy(m) - 1
    If evy(m) = 0 Then Fan x, y, 3 + loopN - 1, 12, 26, 2, GOLD
  ElseIf kd = K_TANK Then
    If t = efire(m) Then
      Fan x, y, loopN, 10, 22, 0, BLUE
      efire(m) = t + 90 - stage * 6
    End If
  ElseIf kd = K_TURRET Then
    If t = efire(m) Then
      Ring x, y, 6 + stage + loopN * 2, t And 31, 18, 0, PINK
      efire(m) = t + 120 - stage * 8
    End If
  ElseIf kd = K_CARRIER Then
    If loopN = 2 And (t And 63) = 63 Then Fan x, y, 2, 20, 24, 1, BLUE
  ElseIf kd = K_GUNSHIP Then
    If ea(m) = 0 Then
      If y >= 76 Then ea(m) = 1 : evy(m) = 0 : et(m) = 0 : t = 0
    ElseIf ea(m) = 1 Then
      If (t Mod (8 - stage \ 2)) = 0 Then
        Shoot x, y + 8, t * 5, 20, 0, PINK
        Shoot x, y + 8, t * 5 + 128, 20, 0, PINK
      End If
      If (t Mod 50) = 25 Then Fan x, y + 8, 5, 10, 28, 1, BLUE
      If t > 420 Then ea(m) = 2 : evy(m) = -14
    End If
  End If
  ex(m) = ex(m) + evx(m) : ey(m) = ey(m) + evy(m)
  et(m) = et(m) + 1
End Sub

Sub Kill(ByVal m As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  chain = chain + 1 : chainT = 90
  If chain > maxChain Then maxChain = chain
  ShowChain
  AddScore kscore(kd) + chain * 20
  Bul.Off m
  If kd = K_CARRIER Then
    If power < 3 Then Drop 1, x, y Else Drop 2, x, y
  End If
  If kd = K_GUNSHIP Then Drop 3, x, y
  ' the second loop: they shoot back as they die
  If loopN = 2 And kair(kd) And alive Then Fan x, y, 1, 0, 26, 2, GOLD
  ek(m) = K_BOOM + kbig(kd) : et(m) = 0 : evx(m) = 0 : ex(m) = x * 16 : ey(m) = y * 16
  If kair(kd) Then evy(m) = 6 Else evy(m) = 16
  If kbig(kd) Then Sfx.Play 1, 31, 0, 15, 30, 1 Else Sfx.Play 1, 20, 1, 13, 12, 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- items
Sub Drop(ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NI - 1
    If ik(n) = 0 Then
      ik(n) = kind : ix(n) = x : iy(n) = y
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub Items()
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NI - 1
    If ik(n) Then
      If (frames And 1) = 0 Then iy(n) = iy(n) + 1
      If iy(n) > 232 Then
        ik(n) = 0 : Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n
      ElseIf alive And Abs(ix(n) - px) < 14 And Abs(iy(n) - py) < 14 Then
        If ik(n) = 1 Then
          If power < 3 Then power = power + 1 Else AddScore 5000
        ElseIf ik(n) = 2 Then
          If bombs < 6 Then bombs = bombs + 1 : ShowBombs
        Else
          AddScore 10000 * loopN
        End If
        ik(n) = 0 : Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n
        Sfx.Play 1, 120, -8, 14, 14, 0
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_ITEM + n, ix(n) - 8, iy(n) - 8, GfxData.S_ITEM + ik(n) - 1, 0
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the boss
Sub StartBoss()
  Dim s As String
  bossOn = 1 : bossX = 128 : bossY = 8 : bossPh = 0 : bossDie = 0 : bossVX = 1 : bossFl = 0
  bossMax = 400 + stage * 200
  If loopN = 2 Then bossMax = bossMax + bossMax \ 2
  bossHP = bossMax
  ' the guns: type (1 ring, 2 aimed fan, 3 spiral, 4 spray, 5 wall), interval, count, speed,
  ' spin, bullet (0 small, 1 big, 2 star), colour - two guns a phase, three phases
  If stage = 1 Then
    s = "2 50 5 22 10 0 2 1 90 12 18 5 1 3 3 5 2 24 9 0 2 2 70 3 30 8 2 4 1 26 16 20 8 0 2 3 7 3 20 -7 1 3"
  ElseIf stage = 2 Then
    s = "3 6 2 22 7 0 2 2 60 7 24 8 1 3 5 44 9 24 0 1 4 2 32 3 32 6 0 2 3 4 3 24 11 0 2 1 50 20 18 4 1 3"
  ElseIf stage = 3 Then
    s = "1 22 10 22 6 0 3 2 45 5 28 9 2 4 3 4 4 22 5 0 2 5 50 11 24 0 1 3 3 5 3 26 -9 0 2 3 5 3 26 9 0 3"
  ElseIf stage = 4 Then
    s = "2 9 1 40 0 2 4 1 60 24 16 5 0 3 1 18 18 22 7 0 2 2 40 7 30 6 1 4 3 3 4 24 7 0 2 2 26 5 34 8 2 4"
  Else
    s = "3 4 3 24 9 0 2 1 40 20 20 6 1 3 3 3 4 22 -6 0 3 2 22 5 32 8 2 4 3 3 5 24 7 0 2 1 20 24 22 5 1 3"
  End If
  Numbers s
  Spr.HideRange SP_BOSS, 12
End Sub

' the boss's numbers from a text of numbers apart by spaces
Sub Numbers(ByVal s As String)
  Dim p As Integer, q As Integer, n As Integer
  longText = s & " "
  p = 1 : n = 0
  Do While p <= Len(longText) And n < 42
    q = InStr(p, longText, " ")
    If q = 0 Then Exit Do
    em(n) = Val(Mid$(longText, p, q - p))
    n = n + 1
    p = q + 1
  Loop
End Sub

Sub BossUpdate()
  Dim h As Integer, ph As Integer, e As Integer, b As Integer, fl As Integer, cx As Integer, cy As Integer, n As Integer
  If bossOn = 0 Then Exit Sub
  If bossDie > 0 Then
    bossDie = bossDie - 1
    If (bossDie And 7) = 0 Then
      n = Spawn(K_BIGBOOM, bossX - 28 + Rnd(56), bossY - 20 + Rnd(40))
      Sfx.Play 1, 31, 0, 15, 20, 1
    End If
    If bossDie = 40 Then
      Spr.HideRange SP_BOSS, 12
      For n = 0 To 5
        e = Spawn(K_BIGBOOM, bossX - 24 + Rnd(48), bossY - 16 + Rnd(32))
      Next
      Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 60, 1
    End If
    If bossDie > 40 Then DrawBoss Spr.Pal * (bossDie And 1)
    If bossDie = 0 Then bossOn = 0 : cleared = 1 : Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 24, 1, 0
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If bossPh = 0 Then
    bossY = bossY + 1
    If bossY >= 84 Then bossPh = 1 : Phase
  Else
    If frames And 1 Then
      bossX = bossX + bossVX
      If bossX < 88 Or bossX > 168 Then bossVX = -bossVX
    End If
    h = Bul.Hits(BOXBOSS)
    If laserHit = BOXBOSS Then h = h + laserDmg
    If bombT > 0 Then h = h + 1
    If h > 0 Then bossHP = bossHP - h : bossFl = 1 : chainT = 90
    If bossHP <= 0 Then
      BossDown
      Exit Sub
    End If
    If bossHP * 3 > bossMax * 2 Then
      ph = 1
    ElseIf bossHP * 3 > bossMax Then
      ph = 2
    Else
      ph = 3
    End If
    If ph <> bossPh Then bossPh = ph : Phase
    For e = 0 To 1
      emT(e) = emT(e) - 1
      If emT(e) <= 0 Then Gun e
    Next
  End If
  If bossY >= 40 Then Bul.Box BOXBOSS, bossX, bossY, 32, 24 Else Bul.Off BOXBOSS
  fl = Spr.Pal * (4 + stage)
  If bossFl And (frames And 7) = 0 Then fl = Spr.Pal
  bossFl = 0
  DrawBoss fl
  If alive And inv = 0 And bombT = 0 Then
    If Abs(px - bossX) < 26 And Abs(py - bossY) < 18 Then Die
  End If
End Sub

' the boss's 12 sprites (4 x 3)
Sub DrawBoss(ByVal fl As Integer)
  Dim cx As Integer, cy As Integer, b As Integer, y As Integer
  b = GfxData.S_BOSS1 + (stage - 1) * 12
  For cy = 0 To 2
    y = bossY - 24 + cy * 16
    For cx = 0 To 3
      If y < 0 Then
        Spr.Hide SP_BOSS + cy * 4 + cx
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_BOSS + cy * 4 + cx, bossX - 32 + cx * 16, y, b + cy * 4 + cx, fl
      End If
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' a new phase: its guns' timers
Sub Phase()
  emT(0) = 30 : emT(1) = 50 : emAng(0) = 0 : emAng(1) = 64
End Sub

' gun e of this phase fires
Sub Gun(ByVal e As Integer)
  Dim o As Integer, typ As Integer, cnt As Integer, spd As Integer, spin As Integer, pat As Integer, pal As Integer, m As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer
  o = (bossPh - 1) * 14 + e * 7
  typ = em(o) : cnt = em(o + 2) : spd = em(o + 3) : spin = em(o + 4) : pat = em(o + 5) : pal = em(o + 6)
  emT(e) = em(o + 1)
  If loopN = 2 Then emT(e) = emT(e) * 3 \ 4
  If emT(e) < 2 Then emT(e) = 2
  x = bossX : y = bossY + 16
  If typ = 1 Then
    Ring x, y, cnt, emAng(e), spd, pat, pal
    emAng(e) = emAng(e) + spin
  ElseIf typ = 2 Then
    Fan x, y, cnt, spin, spd, pat, pal
  ElseIf typ = 3 Then
    Ring x, y, cnt, emAng(e), spd, pat, pal
    emAng(e) = emAng(e) + spin
  ElseIf typ = 4 Then
    For m = 1 To cnt
      Shoot x, y, 192 + Rnd(128), spd, pat, pal
    Next
  Else
    For m = 0 To cnt - 1
      Shoot bossX - 48 + m * 96 \ (cnt - 1), y, 0, spd, pat, pal
    Next
  End If
End Sub

Sub BossDown()
  Dim n As Integer, bonus As Long
  bossDie = 150
  Bul.Off BOXBOSS
  n = Bul.Clear()
  bonus = 50000
  bonus = bonus * stage * loopN + n * 100
  AddScore bonus
  chain = chain + 1 : chainT = 90
  If chain > maxChain Then maxChain = chain
  ShowChain
  bonus = chain
  AddScore bonus * 500
  Message "BOSS DOWN!", 120
End Sub

' its life across the top of the play area
Sub BossBar()
  Dim v As Integer, f As Integer
  If bossPh = 0 Or bossDie > 0 Then Exit Sub
  v = bossHP * 11 \ (bossMax \ 16)
  If v = bossBarV Then Exit Sub
  bossBarV = v
  For k = 0 To 21
    f = v - k * 8
    If f < 0 Then f = 0
    If f > 8 Then f = 8
    Tiles.Put 5 + k, 4, GfxData.T_GAUGE + f
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Bg.cls
files.text:
' Bg - the scrolling background on Layer 2: 16 x 16 blocks, the hardware scrolling it down a line
' a frame, one new line drawn at the top each time (the line about to come into view).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Layer 2 is 256 x 192 in 16K bank 16 (8K pages 32-37); only the left 192 pixels are shown (its
' clip window), 12 blocks across. Drawing maps the page it needs into MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF)
' and puts bank 5's first half back after (the tilemap's tiles live there).
' A frame (just after Frame, so the new line is drawn before the picture reaches it):
'     If Bg.Phase() = 0 Then  ...Bg.Cell c, block for the 12 cells of the next block row...
'     Bg.Scroll
' Phase(): the block row's line drawn last (15 down to 0): 0 = the row is done, set the next.
Option Explicit

Private cells(15) As Byte          ' the block row being drawn: 12 block numbers
Private top As Integer             ' Layer 2's scroll (NextReg #17): the buffer line shown at the top
Private phs As Integer           ' the block's line drawn last (15 .. 0)
Private blk As Integer             ' the blocks' address
Private col As Integer             ' the colour sets' address
Private cnt As Integer

' Init blocks, colours: Layer 2 on (256 x 192, bank 16, the left 192 pixels shown), the first set
' of colours
Public Sub Init(ByVal blocks As Integer, ByVal colours As Integer)
  blk = blocks : col = colours
  top = 0 : phs = 0
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0                         ' 256 x 192
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16                        ' 16K bank 16
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1                         ' its clip window: the left 192 pixels
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Theme 0
  Out &H123B, 2                          ' Layer 2 visible
End Sub

' Theme n: the colours of stage n (0-4), or 5 the bomb's flash
Public Sub Theme(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; HL = col + n * 48
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, ({col})
            add hl, de
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43               ; Layer 2's first palette, written in turn
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, #10
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld e, 48
th_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, th_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43               ; back to the ULA's palette (others write #41 too)
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Cell c, b: cell c (0-11) of the next block row is block b
Public Sub Cell(ByVal c As Integer, ByVal b As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 15
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, {cells}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Phase(): the line of the block row drawn last (0: the row is finished)
Public Function Phase() As Integer
  Phase = phs
End Function

' Scroll: everything down a line, the new top line drawn (the next line up of the block row)
Public Sub Scroll()
#asm
            ld a, ({phs})
            dec a
            and 15
            ld ({phs}), a
            ld c, a                 ; C = the block's line
            ld a, ({top})           ; the buffer line: top - 1, 191 after 0
            or a
            jr nz, sc_dec
            ld a, 192
sc_dec:
            dec a
            ld ({top}), a
            ld b, a
            rlca                    ; its page: 32 + line / 32
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            add a, 32
            ld e, a
            ld a, b
            and 31
            add a, #C0
            ld d, a                 ; D = #C0 + line mod 32 (the address's high byte)
            ld a, e
            ld (sc_pg + 1), a
            ld a, c                 ; the source offset in a block: line * 16
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld (sc_off + 1), a
            ld e, 0                 ; DE = the line's first pixel
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
sc_pg:
            ld a, 0
            out (c), a
            ld hl, {cells}
            ld (sc_hl + 1), hl
            ld a, 12
            ld ({cnt}), a
sc_cell:
sc_hl:
            ld hl, 0
            ld a, (hl)              ; the block: blk + b * 256 + line * 16
            inc hl
            ld (sc_hl + 1), hl
            ld hl, ({blk})
            add a, h
            ld h, a
sc_off:
            ld a, 0
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, sc_nc
            inc h
sc_nc:
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jr nz, sc_cell
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #17               ; the new line at the top
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, ({top})
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Bul.cls
files.text:
' Bul - the bullet engine: 60 enemy bullets and 18 player shots as hardware sprites 50-127,
' moved, checked and drawn in Z80 every frame. (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Coordinates are the sprites' (Spr.cls): the 256 x 192 paper is 32-287 across, 32-223 down; the
' play area is the left 192 pixels (32-223 across). Positions are centres.
' Enemy bullets move in 1/256ths of a pixel (an angle and a speed: Fire); they go when they
' leave the play area. Step tells you if one is on the player (within 3 pixels of the centre:
' the ship's hit box is its middle, not its wings).
' Shots move up 10 pixels a frame (and vx across) and hit boxes: up to 24 targets Main puts down
' each frame (Box n, x, y, half width, half height - make them a little wider than the art),
' each counting its hits until Hits(n) reads them. Laser(x, y) finds the nearest box straight
' above, and LaserTop() where the beam stops.
' A frame:  Bul.Step px, py  (moves all, writes the sprites' table)
'           Frame : Bul.Show (the table to the hardware)
Option Explicit

Private eb(599) As Byte           ' 60 bullets x 10: x (lo, hi), y (lo, hi), vx, vy, pattern (255 = none), palette
Private sh(71) As Byte            ' 18 shots x 4: x, y, vx, on
Private bx(143) As Byte           ' 24 boxes x 6: on, x, y, half width, half height, hits
Private att(389) As Byte          ' 78 sprites x 5
Private hitF As Integer, live As Integer, spk As Integer, spkX As Integer, spkY As Integer
Private ltop As Integer, cnt As Integer, ang As Integer, tmp As Integer, vx As Integer, vy As Integer
Private sa3 As Integer, sa4 As Integer, six As Integer
Private atn(16) As Integer

' Init shotPattern: everything cleared, the shots' sprite pattern
Public Sub Init(ByVal shotPattern As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  sa3 = &HC0 Or (shotPattern \ 2)
  sa4 = &H80 Or ((shotPattern And 1) * 64)
  ' atan(k / 16) in 256ths of a turn
  atn(0) = 0 : atn(1) = 3 : atn(2) = 5 : atn(3) = 8 : atn(4) = 10 : atn(5) = 12 : atn(6) = 15 : atn(7) = 17
  atn(8) = 19 : atn(9) = 21 : atn(10) = 23 : atn(11) = 25 : atn(12) = 26 : atn(13) = 28 : atn(14) = 29
  atn(15) = 31 : atn(16) = 32
  tmp = Sines()
  Reset
End Sub

' Reset: no bullets, no shots, no boxes
Public Sub Reset()
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 60
rs_b:
            ld (hl), 255
            add hl, de
            djnz rs_b
            ld hl, {sh}
            ld b, 72
rs_s:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_s
            ld hl, {bx}
            ld b, 144
rs_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_x
            ld hl, {att}
            ld b, 78
rs_a:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #40
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_a
#endasm
End Sub

' Clear(): every enemy bullet gone (a bomb, a boss beaten): how many there were
Public Function Clear() As Integer
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld bc, 60 * 256
cl_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, cl_n
            ld (hl), 255
            inc c
cl_n:
            add hl, de
            djnz cl_lp
            pop hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fire x, y, a, spd, pat, pal: an enemy bullet from x, y going way a (0-255: 0 down, 64 right,
' 128 up, 192 left) at spd sixteenths of a pixel a frame, sprite pattern pat in palette pal
Public Sub Fire(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ang}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_s1 + 1), a
            ld (fi_s2 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_p + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (fi_c + 1), a
            ld hl, {eb} + 8         ; a free one
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 60
fi_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, fi_got
            add hl, de
            djnz fi_find
            jp fi_done
fi_got:
            ld de, -8
            add hl, de
            ld ({tmp}), hl
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vx = sin(a) * spd / 8
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n1
            inc h
fi_n1:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p1
            neg
fi_p1:
            ld d, a
fi_s1:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v1:
            ld ({vx}), de
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vy = sin(a + 64) * spd / 8
            add a, 64
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n2
            inc h
fi_n2:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p2
            neg
fi_p2:
            ld d, a
fi_s2:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e

' Aim(x, y, tx, ty): the way (0-255, as Fire's) from x, y to tx, ty
Public Function Aim(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal tx As Integer, ByVal ty As Integer) As Integer
  Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, ax As Integer, ay As Integer, t As Integer
  dx = tx - x : dy = ty - y
  ax = Abs(dx) : ay = Abs(dy)
  If ax = 0 And ay = 0 Then
    Aim = 0
    Exit Function
  End If
  If ax <= ay Then
    t = atn(ax * 16 \ ay)
  Else
    t = 64 - atn(ay * 16 \ ax)
  End If
  If dy >= 0 Then
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = t Else Aim = (256 - t) And 255
  Else
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = 128 - t Else Aim = 128 + t
  End If
End Function
